title: Negative: declared-surface bound weakened
description: Violates command-contract.md §4.1 declared-surface bound (ADR-026 §3; verification-contract.md §4.4 consistency): exchangeRules.emptyDeclarationProceedsWithGenericOperations is declared false — the declaration asserts that declaring nothing must not proceed with generic operations, i.e. an empty declaration blocks or alters the exchange. Declaring nothing is legal and the runtime proceeds with its generic operations for the lifecycle positions the standard does not cover; the bound is a no-op, not an open door. The schema encodes the rejection as a const-true rule declaration: 'false' fails the const.
